result.one_liner: Shopify is a cloud-based ecommerce platform providing REST and GraphQL APIs for building apps and integrations with Shopify stores.

evidence.quote: OAuth 2.0, a widely-recognized protocol for authorizing applications that allows apps to securely access resources without exposing user credentials
Session tokens - short-lived JWTs - to verify that a request from your app's frontend originates from a valid shop
The Shopify Partner Program is free to join and has zero revenue minimums at the entry tier
Development accounts provide access to all Shopify features and tools, including the Shopify Admin, APIs, and theme customizations, free of charge
REST endpoints receive no new capabilities. Shopify is investing all new features exclusively in GraphQL
GraphQL queries are executed by sending POST HTTP requests to the endpoint: https://{store_name}.myshopify.com/admin/api/2026-07/graphql.json

result.notes: Shopify offers free developer accounts through its Partner Program with test stores for development. OAuth 2.0 is the primary authentication for public apps; REST API is deprecated for new apps but GraphQL is fully supported. Both APIs available but REST deprecated. No MCP server found in search results.
